grand_dice.//: Story Phase 12: the Grand Dice of Grandness (DISPLAY MODEL - NOT FOR SALE). Purple foam, pips the size of plates, the durations printed on stickers under the pips. Three is printed ONE DAY (the booklet's Table B says six hours: a misprint; the Grand Dice are always correct). It is full of Mexican jumping beans. Its results are always the story's.
